about: The login screen after a session that ended because of a problem (docs/adr/0065-the-session-ending-because-of-a-problem.mdx, decision 2): the login program saw the last session crash or hang and says so to the login screen's session (OXYOS_LAST_SESSION_ENDED=problem), which the login screen asks as it is shown ({"lastSession": {}}). It says, quietly under its field, "Your session ended because of a problem.", a text the assistive technology reads with the screen; the person signs in as always. Without the word, the same login screen says nothing of it (login-screen, login-power).
